summary: Frontend-only donation feature testing completed on public preview URL. Core donation flows work, with one mobile contrast/design issue observed.

design_issues.screen: Donate page (mobile 375px and similar small widths)
issues: Step 02 icon/label text appears low-contrast against the lighter background transition area, reducing readability.

action_items: Improve mobile contrast/readability for Step 02 block on /donate where dark-to-light background transition occurs.
Optionally harden copy-to-clipboard UX with a fallback path when clipboard permissions are denied.
critical_code_review_comments: Donation page, Navbar, Footer, and route wiring are structurally sound with testids in place.
No hardcoded backend URL misuse in tested files; frontend API usage references REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
No payment reference submission form present on donation page (as requested).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://prep-changes-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Desktop donate nav, mobile donate nav, donation details, QR visibility, no reference form, and donate->home anchor routing passed. Initial copy test failed due clipboard permission context in automation; passed after granting clipboard permissions in browser context.
rca of the issue: Mobile contrast issue likely caused by step block text color blending with the lighter section as content crosses from dark gradient into patterned light background at small widths. Mitigation: enforce darker text/icon color for mobile in step blocks or maintain dark backing behind full step section on small screens.
